name: West Hazleton Borough
hero_alt: Kobalt paving crew resurfacing a residential street, West Hazleton Borough
paragraphs: Kobalt Construction repaved a residential street for West Hazleton Borough, milling the deteriorated roadway surface and laying fresh asphalt curb to curb.

Our crew worked efficiently through the neighborhood, keeping residents informed and access maintained throughout the project, and left the borough with a smoothly resurfaced street built to handle years of traffic ahead.
summary: Full-width residential roadway milling and paving.
